svg.title: mike system map, animated
svg.desc: Animated diagram. A Claude Code request goes through the mike proxy on port 9988 to Anthropic; the original bytes and the response are written to Postgres; a NOTIFY updates the web UI over /api/ws; mike-mcp lets Claude Code query the capture through the inspect API. The optional proxy-forward sidecar on 9987 routes traffic to 9988 or fails over to Anthropic.
svg.text: One turn, every port it touches

g.text: Claude Code runs with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9988, so every model call lands on mike first.
The original bytes are kept, and a stub row goes in
engine::accept keeps the untouched inbound body before any stage runs. The Phase-1 stub row is
attempted before forwarding when persistence is available; it establishes the durable RequestId.
Rewrites depend on settings, authored rules and queued messages. This example follows the plain path;
the logical inbound capture stays separate from the forwarded representation.
The stream is tee'd: live to Claude Code, and into the SSE parser that fills in the capture.
The terminal snapshot persists completion metadata and the response. Normalized capture may later
reconstruct compacted bodies; body APIs report provenance and fidelity. There is no separate blob store.
NOTIFY proxy.row_changed → LISTEN task → event_tx → /api/ws. Views also fetch or poll their own data.
Claude asks mike about its own session
mike-mcp uses stdio and the inspect API. Body reads expose fidelity; select narrows returned JSON.
proxy-forward :9987 is HTTPS MITM. Ordinary non-WebSocket /v1/* and /v2/* HTTP requests use :9988;
WebSocket upgrades go direct; unhealthy-capture failover also goes straight to api.anthropic.com.
